Its KeyEvent constructor asserts matches(e), and its matches override delegates to the protected Keybind matcher with ignoreModifiers=true.

evidence.detail: Exact v308 stores keyCode and modifiers, exposes NOT_SET/CTRL/ALT/SHIFT static instances, normalizes modifier key codes, masks supported modifiers, and implements equals/hashCode/toString over the pair.
Constructors accept either keyCode/modifier ints or KeyEvent; matches(KeyEvent) handles pressed/released events, modifier-only bindings, and the same modifier normalization used during construction.
